requirements.quote: Write the final, human-readable report to a new file, exactly named
*   Each line of `service_frequency.log` must follow this precise pattern (note the colon, space, and no leading zeroes):
Your goal is to create a frequency report that tells how many times each service appears in that list.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import sys,collections
c=collections.Counter(l.strip() for l in open('\''/home/user/releases/services_2023-10.txt'\'') if l.strip())
exp='\'''\''.join('\''%s: %d\n'\''%(k,v) for k,v in sorted(c.items(),key=lambda kv:(-kv[1],kv[0])))
got=open('\''/home/user/releases/service_frequency.log'\'').read()
sys.exit(0 if got==exp or got==exp.rstrip('\''\n'\'') else 1)'
